caption: The drawing depicts two elongated, curved metal objects placed side by side, each with large circular loops at both ends. The object on the left is decorated with intricate geometric and floral patterns in white, blue, and silver tones, featuring a central circular motif with radiating blue designs, and outlined in dark brown or bronze. The object on the right has a plainer design, rendered in brown shades with smooth surfaces and subtle highlights, lacking decorative embellishments. Both objects are identical in shape, having wavy contours and pointed protrusions along their edges, but only the left one has the decorative detailing. The background is a plain, off-white color, and there is a handwritten signature, “A. Zegli,” at the lower right corner of the image.
